findings.source: PolygonRollupManagerPreviousV1toV2.sol:1647-1665 while (currentNodes != 1) { ... for (uint256 i = 0; i < nextIterationNodes; i++) {...} ... remainingLevels--; }
findings.issue: In this inlining of getRollupExitRoot the outer while and the inner for are flattened into one while True: the inner index s is reset by the outer step and the two loop tests appear as 'if s < y' and 'if y != 1' inside one body, so the nesting is lost (the other inlinings print the two nested loops correctly).
findings.rule: When a loop header is re-entered from a back edge that resets the induction variable after a different exit test, split it into an outer loop (test y != 1) containing the inner loop (test s < y).
